# Responsible Data and AI Practice in the Kingdom

> Make one AI build lawful and responsible: map and minimise its personal data, classify and share it under the national policies, test it against the ethics principles and write its risk register and disclosure. SDAIA Academy course FN-106, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 16,617 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Personal data and the law](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/slides/day1.md): Map, justify, minimise, pseudonymise and keep the data of one build; sessions: Where personal data flows in a build, Lawful basis and minimisation, Pseudonymisation and its limits, Rights, retention and breaches; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/slides/day1.html; about 5,818 tokens
- [Day 2: Classify, share and send](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/slides/day2.md): Classify each data set, decide where it may go, and check what you reuse; sessions: Data classification levels, What may reach an external model, Sharing with another entity, Licences and provenance; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/slides/day2.html; about 5,011 tokens
- [Day 3: Ethics and risk in practice](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/slides/day3.md): Turn the principles into tests, rate the risks and tell parents the truth; sessions: Principles into tests, Testing the assistant, Risk tier and risk register, Disclosure and human review; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/slides/day3.html; about 4,457 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: the responsible build pack](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/slides/capstone.md): Ten-minute reviews: six minutes to present the pack, four for the assessor's changed fact; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/slides/capstone.html; about 784 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Trace Wafi's personal data](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/labs/D1_1_map_every_field.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Lawful basis and minimum fields](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/labs/D1_2_set_lawful_basis.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Pseudonymise, then attack](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/labs/D1_3_pseudonymise_guardian_student.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Retention and a seeded breach](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/labs/D1_4_write_retention_rule.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Classify six data sets](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/labs/D2_1_classify_six_data.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Hosted, local or neither](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/labs/D2_2_decide_each_data.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: A partner's data request](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/labs/D2_3_assess_partner_entity.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Licences and provenance](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/labs/D2_4_check_licences_two.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Three checks](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/labs/D3_1_write_three_checks.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Forty enquiries](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/labs/D3_2_run_forty_scripted.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Tier and register](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/labs/D3_3_place_assistant_risk.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: Notice and routing rule](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fn-106/labs/D3_4_draft_notice_parents.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
